claims.claim: The matched four-update LoRA mechanism pilot completed with the frozen base/vision and source-balanced target loss.
claims.not_supported: Convergence, final held-out loss reduction, design learning, cold optimizer resume.

claims.claim: The action-context treatment supplies the teacher-forced reason prefix only in paired action examples; both arms supervise the same reason and action targets.
claims.not_supported: A general proof that all forms of pairing outperform all forms of separate learning. Reason-only examples in both groups already see the scene.

claims.claim: The Casa base/separate/paired development attempts produced 7/6/6 furniture instances and two detected contact pairs each.
claims.not_supported: Independent project population effect, calibrated professional quality, or a formal 0/3 binary success rate.

claims.claim: All ten pilot demonstration actions were moves of already populated rooms; Casa evaluation began with no furniture and required construction.
claims.not_supported: That this mismatch caused the observed failures or that correcting it will produce learning gains.

claims.claim: A separate untrained candidate now provides nine native additions with one reused source reason and fifty bound views.
claims.not_supported: Nine independent professional decisions, source diversity growth, complete fixture installation, human-use acceptance or training improvement.

claims.claim: Pairing professional reasons with editable scene decisions improves unseen whole-room design beyond same-material separate learning and strong non-training baselines.
